description: Mechanics helpers for the Machinome framework: gear, screw, crank, delta, cam, belt, rolling, indexing and linkage formulas for numeric poses and symbolic motion.
rules: machinome-mechanics 0.1.0 was released with Machinome 0.7.0 and requires Machinome 0.7 or newer; solid-node 0.6.0 does not satisfy it.
Install with pip install 'machinome[mechanics]'. Import helpers from machinome_mechanics; the framework never imports or re-exports them.
Angles are degrees. The same helpers accept numbers and machinome's symbolic driving values, so one formula serves a numeric pose and a relation law.
Use a helper inside a project's relation law, for example crank.turn.drives(piston.rise, law=piston_law) where the law calls piston_height.
The package supplies formulas only. The project supplies dimensions, reference frames, signs, branch selection and assembly facts.
